confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for a July 2026 peak-season window in Faro, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are moderately confident; accommodation and cocktail prices are less certain and seasonal swings are likely. The FX value comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA. I did not open the RBA page directly, and other sources in the results showed slightly different rates (about 0.698 for 9 Oct 2026), so verify it against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of southern Portuguese coastal tourist towns (Algarve) and lower-tier Lisbon pricing, adjusted slightly down for Faro's smaller size. Summer tourist-season pricing assumed for accommodation and bars. Cocktail and wine anchors were set using the usual local ratio to draft beer, since direct knowledge of specific bar prices is weak.
